messages:
anya: Quick follow-up to the CP peering discussion. Proposal: minimize controlplane stitching and push NAT/state to edge relays.
leo: short version: CP keeps tenant metadata only (policy, preferred_relay). relays hold leases + EIP mapping.
mike: major wins: less CP churn, simpler cutbacks. Concerns: observability, cert flow, and EIP exhaustion.
jen: For static-IP customers we either: 1) give a per-tenant EIP pool relays draw from, or 2) CP keeps a small vip NAT mapping. Tradeoffs?
anya: we prefer option 1 for scale; CP records lease ids only. option 2 is fallback for a few high-SLA tenants.
infra-bot: note: previous EIP exhaustion incident 2024-10-02. Add quota and alerting.
leo: rollout: opt-in beta -> tracing A/B -> allowlist EIP-mode -> enable CP fallback proxy for emergencies.
mike: API sketch: acquire_lease(tenant, placement_tags)-> {lease_id, eip, expires_at}; renew/release/query. idempotent.
jen: ops needs: revoke-lease playbook, drain behavior, EIP pool alarms, and a force-legacy toggle for quick rollback.
anya: Action items: mike prototype lease API + metrics (2w), jen update runbooks (1w), leo finalize placement tags (1w). I'll merge RFC follow-up after prototypes.
